chinese: 增加；擴大；增強

chinese: 聽覺的；耳的；聽力的

chinese: 贊助；支持；主辦；保護；預兆

chinese: 樸素的；無裝飾的；嚴厲的；嚴峻的；苦行的

chinese: 鑑定…為真；證實；認證；使具法律效力

chinese: adj. 權宜的；有利的；方便的；n. 權宜之計；應急手段

chinese: 加速；促進；迅速處理

chinese: 贖（罪）；補償；彌補

chinese: 詳細解釋；闡明；剖析

chinese: v. 利用；剝削；開發（資源）；n. 功績；英勇事蹟

chinese: 詳細闡述；解釋；說明

chinese: 明確地；清楚地；特意地；專門地

chinese: 刪除；抹去；消除

chinese: 現存的；尚存的

chinese: 無關的；不相干的；外來的；不必要的

definition: extremely poor; a poor person
chinese: adj. 貧困的；窮困的；n. 窮人

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: angry at something perceived as unjust
chinese: 憤慨的；義憤填膺的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: unable to be challenged or denied; beyond doubt
chinese: 無可爭辯的；不容置疑的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: unable to be broken or undone; permanent; incapable of being dissolved
chinese: 牢不可破的；不可廢除的；不可分解的；不溶解的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to teach a doctrine or ideology so that it is accepted uncritically
chinese: 灌輸（思想）；教化；使盲目接受

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: lazy; averse to activity; (of a disease) slow to develop and causing little pain
chinese: 懶惰的；怠惰的；（醫）進展緩慢的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: impossible to subdue or defeat; unyielding
chinese: 不屈不撓的；不可征服的；不屈服的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: too evident to be doubted; certain
chinese: 無可置疑的；確實的；明顯的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to persuade or influence; to bring about or cause; to bring on (labor) artificially; to infer by induction
chinese: 勸誘；引起；導致；（醫）催生；歸納（推論）
example: Because of the increasing risk of complications the doctor decided to induce labor.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: tolerance or leniency; the act of indulging; something indulged in; a remission of punishment for sin
chinese: 寬容；縱容；沉溺；嗜好；（宗教）赦罪

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: drunk; intoxicated with emotion or excitement
chinese: 酒醉的；陶醉的；狂喜的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: too great or extreme to be expressed in words; too sacred to be uttered
chinese: 難以言喻的；不可言傳的；（因神聖）不可說出的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: impossible to avoid or escape; inevitable
chinese: 無法逃避的；必然的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: lacking skill or competence; clumsy; inappropriate; absurd
chinese: 無能的；笨拙的；不得當的；荒謬的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: sluggish; lacking vigor; unable to move; chemically inactive
chinese: 遲鈍的；無活力的；不活動的；（化學）惰性的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: certain to happen; unavoidable
chinese: 不可避免的；必然的
example: An accident is an inevitable occurrence due to the action of immutable natural laws.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: impossible to stop or prevent; relentless; not moved by persuasion or pleading
chinese: 無法阻擋的；不可動搖的；無情的；不為所動的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: incapable of making mistakes; never failing; certain to work
chinese: 絕無錯誤的；絕對可靠的；必定有效的
example: an infallible antidote
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: well known for something bad; notorious; shameful
chinese: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的；可恥的
example: I glare resentfully at the crimson letter, is this the infamous red-paper draft notice?
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: childish; immature; of or relating to infants or infancy
chinese: 幼稚的；不成熟的；嬰兒的；嬰兒期的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: able to spread disease; contagious; (of a feeling) likely to spread to others
chinese: 傳染性的；易傳染的；有感染力的
example: A warming ocean causes thermal stress that contributes to coral bleaching and infectious disease.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to deduce or conclude from evidence and reasoning
chinese: 推斷；推論；得出結論
example: I can infer that something went wrong here, even if I don't know what.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: of or like hell; fiendish; detestable or awful
chinese: 地獄的；惡魔般的；可惡的；糟透的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a person who rejects a particular religion; an unbeliever; unbelieving
chinese: n. 異教徒；無宗教信仰者；adj. 不信教的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: extremely or immeasurably small
chinese: 極微小的；無限小的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: physical or mental weakness; an illness; a weakness of character
chinese: 虛弱；體弱；疾病；（性格）弱點

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: exaggerated; (of prices) artificially high; filled with air; swollen; pompous
chinese: 誇大的；（價格）過高的；充氣的；膨脹的；自負的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an arrival or entry of large numbers of people or things
chinese: 湧入；大量流入

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a violation of a rule or law; a minor offense
chinese: 違反；違規；輕罪

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to encroach on (rights); to break (a law or agreement); to violate
chinese: 侵犯（權利）；違反（法規）；侵害

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: clever, original, and inventive; cleverly designed
chinese: 巧妙的；精巧的；有創意的；機靈的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: innocent and unsuspecting; naive; candid; lacking cunning
chinese: 天真的；純樸的；坦率的；無心機的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an ungrateful person; ungrateful
chinese: n. 忘恩負義者；adj. 忘恩負義的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to bring (oneself) into favor with someone by deliberate efforts; to curry favor
chinese: 討好；逢迎；巴結

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: existing as a permanent, essential part of something; intrinsic; innate
chinese: 固有的；內在的；本質的；與生俱來的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a feeling that stops one from acting freely; restraint; the act of holding back or preventing
chinese: 拘束；顧忌；抑制；禁止

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: tending to harm or obstruct; unfavorable; hostile
chinese: 有害的；不利的；敵意的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: impossible to imitate; unique; matchless
chinese: 無法模仿的；獨特的；無與倫比的

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: gross injustice; immoral behavior; a wicked act
chinese: 極不公正；邪惡；罪行

definition: to cause (a process) to begin; to introduce to a subject; to admit into a group with rites; a newly admitted member
chinese: v. 發起；開始；使入門；使入會；n. 新加入者；入門者

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a court order requiring or forbidding an act; an authoritative command; a warning
chinese: （法院）禁制令；命令；告誡

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a slight knowledge or vague notion; a hint
chinese: 模糊的概念；略知；暗示

definition: inborn; natural rather than learned; inherent
chinese: 天生的；先天的；固有的

chinese: 無害的；無冒犯性的；平淡無奇的

chinese: 創新；革新；引進（新事物）

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

chinese: 影射；暗諷；含沙射影

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

chinese: 過度的；過分的；無節制的

definition: impossible to satisfy; greedy
chinese: 無法滿足的；貪得無厭的

definition: impossible to understand or interpret; enigmatic; mysterious
chinese: 難以理解的；不可測的；高深莫測的

definition: proceeding gradually and subtly but with harmful effect; treacherous; crafty
chinese: 暗中為害的；潛伏的；陰險的；狡詐的

chinese: 有洞察力的；見解深刻的

definition: to suggest (something bad) indirectly; to hint; to work (oneself) into favor by subtle means; to slip in gradually
chinese: 暗示（負面之事）；影射；巧妙地鑽營；慢慢潛入

definition: lacking interest or vigor; dull; bland; lacking flavor
chinese: 乏味的；無趣的；平淡的；淡而無味的

chinese: 無禮的；傲慢的；粗魯的

chinese: adj. 無力償債的；破產的；n. 破產者

chinese: 失眠；失眠症

chinese: 漫不經心的；不在乎的；無憂無慮的

definition: to provoke or incite (someone) to act; to bring about or initiate (an action)
chinese: 煽動；教唆；發起
example: They used every means in their power to instigate the people against him.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: defiant of authority; disobedient to orders
chinese: 不服從的；違抗命令的

definition: narrow-minded; interested only in one's own group; isolated; of or relating to an island
chinese: 狹隘的；偏狹的；孤立的；島嶼的

definition: impossible to overcome; insurmountable
chinese: 無法克服的；不可逾越的

definition: a rebellion or uprising against authority
chinese: 叛亂；暴動；起義

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a violent uprising against an authority or government; rebellion
chinese: 叛亂；暴動；起義

chinese: 完整無缺的；原封不動的；未受損的

chinese: 整合；使融合；使成一體；（種族）融合

definition: adherence to moral principles; honesty; the state of being whole and undivided; soundness
chinese: 正直；誠實；完整；完好

chinese: adj. 智力的；理智的；有才智的；n. 知識分子

definition: intellectuals or highly educated people as a social group
chinese: 知識階層；知識界

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to place (a dead body) in a grave or tomb; to bury
chinese: 埋葬；安葬

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to prohibit or forbid; to intercept or cut off (supply lines); an authoritative prohibition
chinese: v. 禁止；阻斷；攔截；n. 禁令

chinese: adj. 臨時的；暫時的；過渡的；n. 過渡期間；其間

definition: a person who takes part in a conversation or dialogue
chinese: 對話者；談話對象；交談者

chinese: 無止盡的；冗長乏味的

chinese: 插入；添加（文字）；篡改；（數學）內插；推估

definition: to intervene; to place or come between; to interrupt with (a remark)
chinese: 介入；插入；置於中間；插話

definition: a period between two reigns or governments; any pause or interval
chinese: 過渡期；空位期；間歇

sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

chinese: 審問；訊問；質詢；仔細探究

definition: occurring or situated between the stars
chinese: 星際的

definition: to come between so as to prevent or alter a result; to mediate; to occur in the meantime; to interfere
chinese: 介入；干預；調停；（時間）介於其間；阻撓

chinese: adj. 親密的；私密的；精通的；v. 暗示；透露；n. 密友

chinese: 威嚇；恐嚇；使膽怯

definition: hard to solve or manage; stubborn; difficult to control or mold
chinese: 棘手的；難以處理的；倔強的；難駕馭的

chinese: 不妥協的；固執的；不讓步的

definition: fearless; adventurous; resolutely bold
chinese: 無畏的；勇敢的；大膽的

chinese: 錯綜複雜的；精細的；難懂的

definition: belonging naturally; essential; inherent
chinese: 固有的；內在的；本質的

definition: inclined to examine one's own thoughts and feelings
chinese: 內省的；自省的

chinese: n. 內向的人；adj. 內向的

chinese: 直覺的；憑直覺的；易懂易用的

chinese: 習以為常的；已麻木的；堅強的

chinese: 誘騙；哄騙；以甜言蜜語誘使

example: They apologize for the paltry offering and hope you'll accept $50,000.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a supposed remedy for all ills or difficulties; a cure-all
chinese: 萬靈丹；萬能藥；解決一切問題的方法
example: It's no panacea, but it can serve as a temporary remedy.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: flamboyant confidence of style or manner; dash; a plume of feathers on a helmet
chinese: 神氣十足；瀟灑的氣派；華麗風采；（頭盔上的）羽飾
example: You have to lose with panache.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an outbreak of disease spreading over a whole country or the world; (of a disease) widespread; prevalent everywhere
chinese: n. 全球大流行病；大流行；adj. （疾病）大範圍流行的；普遍的
example: What this pandemic has provided is an opportunity to reflect on these many blessings.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: wild and noisy disorder or confusion; uproar
chinese: 大混亂；喧囂；騷動
example: When the musicians threw t-shirts into the audience, pandemonium ensued.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a public speech or text in high praise of someone or something; a eulogy
chinese: 頌詞；讚頌文；頌揚
example: The art review sounded more like a panegyric than a neutral assessment.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a sudden sharp pain; a sudden painful emotion or feeling
chinese: 一陣劇痛；一陣痛苦；悲痛
example: Benedito felt a pang of worry when his billy goat failed to return at nightfall.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a complete or impressive collection or array; a splendid display; a full suit of armor
chinese: 一整套；完整陣容；盛大排場；全副盔甲
example: They took to the field with all the panoply of modern warfare.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an unbroken view of a whole region; a comprehensive survey; a wide picture of a scene
chinese: 全景；全貌；概觀；全景畫
example: The hill commands the panorama of the city.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a simple story used to illustrate a moral or religious lesson
chinese: 寓言；比喻；道德故事
example: The parable of the talents is one of my favorites.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a typical example or model of something; a framework of theories and methods; a pattern
chinese: 典範；範式；模式；範例
example: We need to postulate a completely different paradigm to explain all these phenomena.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a seemingly absurd or self-contradictory statement that may be true; a contradictory person or situation
chinese: 矛盾；悖論；似非而是的說法；矛盾的人或事
example: This has been a paradox, but now the time gives it proof.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a model of excellence or perfection; a perfect example of a quality
chinese: 典範；模範；完美典型
example: In this context, “paragon” refers to an ideal instance; a perfect embodiment of a concept.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a limit or boundary defining the scope of something; a variable or constant that determines a system's behavior; a numerical characteristic of a population
chinese: 界限；限定範圍；參數；（統計）母數
example: Even though a parameter's value can change, it is treated as a constant, not as a variable.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: more important than anything else; supreme
chinese: 至高無上的；最重要的；首要的
example: The regular upkeep of our servers is paramount to ensuring high uptime.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a mental condition marked by delusions of persecution; unjustified suspicion and mistrust of others
chinese: 偏執狂；多疑；被害妄想
example: The virus also drives humans insane, causing an increase in anger and paranoia worldwide.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: personal belongings; the equipment or articles needed for a particular activity
chinese: 隨身用品；用具；裝備；全套相關物品
example: They parked in their space at the campground and began unloading all of their paraphernalia.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to express the meaning of in different words; a restatement of a text in other words
chinese: v. 改述；意譯；釋義；n. 改寫；意譯
example: Don't repeat or paraphrase the question you're being asked because it sounds patronizing.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: dried out by heat; extremely thirsty; (of grain) roasted
chinese: 乾透的；焦乾的；極渴的；（穀物）炒過的
example: The person who consumes chili will be parched.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an outcast; a person who is despised or rejected by society
chinese: 被排斥者；遭唾棄的人；賤民
example: The once eminent scientist, upon being inculpated for fudging his data, has become a pariah in the research community.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the state of being equal, especially in pay or status; equivalence of currency value; (math) the property of being odd or even
chinese: 平等；同等；對等；（經濟）平價；（數學）奇偶性
example: Guterres, who referred to himself as “a proud feminist,” also called for dismantling the “patriarchy” and moving toward gender parity.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a conference between opposing sides to discuss terms; to hold a discussion with an enemy
chinese: n. （敵對雙方的）談判；會談；v. 談判；和談
example: The two opposing armies intended to parley in order to exchange hostages.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: full of danger or uncertainty; precarious; hard to deal with
chinese: 危險的；岌岌可危的；難以應付的
example: Thou art in a parlous state, shepherd.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: having a limited or narrow outlook; provincial; relating to a church parish
chinese: 狹隘的；眼界窄的；地方性的；教區的
example: Jasmine was sad to admit it, but her fledgling relationship with Jacob did not work out because his culinary tastes were simply too parochial; “After all,” she quipped on her blog, “he considered Chef Boyrdee ethnic food.”
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an imitation of a style for comic effect; a feeble or absurd imitation; to imitate mockingly
chinese: n. 諷刺性模仿作品；拙劣的模仿；v. 戲謔模仿；拙劣地模仿
example: The newspaper published a hilarious parody of the president's speech.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a sudden outburst of emotion or activity; a sudden attack or intensification of a disease
chinese: （情緒的）突然爆發；一陣發作；（疾病的）陣發
example: Then suddenly he slapped his thigh in a paroxysm of amusement.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to repeat mechanically without understanding; a tropical bird that can mimic speech; a person who repeats without understanding
chinese: v. 鸚鵡學舌般重複；機械模仿；n. 鸚鵡；學舌者
example: Be careful not to leave any small objects around that the parrot could swallow.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to evade (a question) skillfully; to ward off (a blow); a defensive deflection; an evasive reply
chinese: v. 迴避（問題）；擋開（攻擊）；n. （擊劍）擋開；迴避
example: In this context, “parry” means (fencing) blocking a lunge or deflecting it with a circular motion of the sword.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: unwilling to spend money or resources; stingy; (of a theory) using the fewest assumptions
chinese: 極度節儉的；吝嗇的；（理論）簡約的
example: Even with millions in his bank account, Fred was so parsimonious that he followed a diet consisting of nothing more than bread and canned soup.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: strongly and often blindly supporting one party or cause; biased; a committed supporter; a guerrilla fighter
chinese: adj. 黨派性的；偏袒的；有偏見的；n. 堅定支持者；黨羽；游擊隊員
example: The partisan media is trying to keep the protests out of sight.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: accepting what happens without active response; submissive; not resisting; (grammar) in the passive voice
chinese: 被動的；消極的；順從的；不抵抗的；（文法）被動的
example: If you're smart enough, you'll realize doctors are passive-aggressive cunts playing stupid for profit.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: relating to idealized rural life; relating to shepherds; relating to spiritual or personal guidance; a work depicting idealized country life
chinese: adj. 田園的；鄉村風光的；牧人的；（神職人員或教師）關懷輔導的；n. 田園詩；田園作品
example: 'Some schools are better at providing pastoral support to children', he said.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: easily recognizable; obvious; (of leather) glossy; an exclusive government right to an invention; to obtain a patent for
chinese: adj. 明顯的；顯而易見的；（皮革）亮漆的；n. 專利；專利權；v. 取得…的專利
example: He wore a tunic over a silk shirt and high patent leather boots.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: of or like a father; related through the father; paternalistic
chinese: 父親的；父系的；如父親般的；家長式的
example: My paternal grandfather gave his life for his wife, children, and grandchildren.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: capable of causing disease
chinese: 致病的；病原的
example: Infectious diseases are caused by prions, viruses, rickettsia, chlamydia, bacteria, pathogenic fungi and protozoa.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a quality that evokes pity or sadness
chinese: 悲愴感；哀婉動人之處；引人憐憫的力量
example: the film captured all the pathos of their situation
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the male head of a family or tribe; a venerable elder; a founder; a high-ranking bishop in Eastern churches
chinese: 族長；家長；元老；創始人；（東正教）牧首
example: Ziri is our family's patriarch.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: belonging to the aristocracy; refined; an aristocrat; a person of refined upbringing and manners
chinese: adj. 貴族的；出身名門的；高雅的；n. 貴族；名門子弟；有教養的人
example: In this context, “patrician” refers to a person of refined upbringing and manners.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: property inherited from one's father or ancestors; heritage; an endowment belonging to a church
chinese: 遺產；祖傳財產；文化遺產；教會產業
example: In this context, “patrimony” refers to a church endowment.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: support given by a patron; the power to make appointments to public office; regular custom of a business; a condescending manner
chinese: 贊助；資助；（政治）任免權；光顧；惠顧；高高在上的態度
example: We really thank you for your patronage.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to treat with condescension; to support financially; to be a regular customer of
chinese: 以高人一等的態度對待；屈尊俯就；贊助；資助；光顧
example: Americans would respect you more if you did not patronize their culture and language.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the presence of something in only small amounts; scarcity; dearth
chinese: 缺乏；稀少；不足
example: There is a paucity of jobs hiring today that require menial skills, since most jobs have either been automated or outsourced.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a small, relatively unimportant offense or fault
chinese: 小過失；輕罪；小毛病
example: The committee treated the minor bookkeeping error as a peccadillo.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: relating to the chest; a chest muscle; an ornament worn on the chest
chinese: adj. 胸部的；胸肌的；n. 胸肌；胸飾
example: To work your pectoral muscles try doing thirty push-ups.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to embezzle money or property entrusted to one's care
chinese: 盜用；挪用（公款）；侵吞
example: In this context, “peculate” means appropriate (as property entrusted to one's care) fraudulently to one's own use.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: relating to or consisting of money
chinese: 金錢的；金錢上的；財務的
example: I'm suffering from pecuniary embarrassment.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a teacher; an educator, especially a strict or pedantic one
chinese: 教師；教育者；迂腐的教師
example: He is an extremely fine and articulate pedagogue.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: excessively concerned with minor details or rules; showing off learning
chinese: 賣弄學問的；學究式的；拘泥細節的；迂腐的
example: Vanya is even more pedantic than I am.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: lacking imagination or excitement; dull; ordinary; going on foot; a person walking
chinese: adj. 平淡無奇的；乏味的；平庸的；徒步的；n. 行人
example: The ambulance went out of control and came close to running over a pedestrian.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the recorded ancestry of an animal or person; lineage; background or history of something
chinese: 血統；譜系；家世；出身；（事物的）來歷
example: That poodle has an immaculate pedigree, with illustrious ancestors on both sides stretching back generations.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a person of equal standing or age; a member of the British nobility; to look closely or searchingly
chinese: n. 同儕；同輩；地位相等的人；（英國）貴族；v. 凝視；窺視
example: Peer pressure often leads to people doing things they know that they shouldn't do.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: unequaled; unmatched; without peer
chinese: 無與倫比的；無雙的；出類拔萃的
example: They constructed therewith a peerless palace, which was of great beauty and of celestial make.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: easily irritated; bad-tempered; querulous
chinese: 易怒的；暴躁的；愛發牢騷的；脾氣壞的
example: The passage describes its subject as peevish, meaning easily irritated or annoyed.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: expressing contempt or disapproval; disparaging; a word expressing contempt
chinese: adj. 輕蔑的；貶義的；n. 貶義詞
example: In the right tone, any word can become pejorative.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: easily understood; lucid; translucently clear
chinese: 清晰易懂的；清澈的；透明的
example: His pellucid explanation made the complex theory accessible.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to throw things at repeatedly; (of rain) to fall heavily; to run fast; the skin of a fur-bearing animal; full speed
chinese: v. 連續投擲；（雨）猛降；疾奔；n. 毛皮；生皮；全速
example: I just saw this van going full pelt down the middle of the road...
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: relating to punishment or the punishment of offenders; extremely severe
chinese: 刑罰的；刑事的；刑法的；（懲罰）嚴苛的
example: This violates about a million penal codes and every holy book there is.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a strong liking or inclination for something
chinese: 嗜好；偏好；強烈傾向
example: He has a penchant for whistling at pretty ladies he sees on the street.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain; something suspended; a companion piece or counterpart
chinese: 墜飾；吊墜；懸吊物；配對作品
example: Ziri put a picture of the family inside the pendant.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: feeling or showing sorrow for wrongdoing; repentant; a person who repents
chinese: adj. 懺悔的；悔過的；n. 懺悔者；悔罪者
example: The passage describes its subject as penitent, meaning (Roman Catholic Church) a person who repents for wrongdoing (a Roman Catholic may be admitted to penance under the direction of a confessor).
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: engaged in deep or serious thought, often tinged with sadness
chinese: 沉思的；憂思的；若有所思的
example: Holmes was turning the pipe about in his hand, and staring at it in his peculiar pensive way.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: extreme poverty; destitution; extreme scarcity
chinese: 赤貧；貧困；匱乏
example: The artist lived in cheerful penury, valuing his freedom more than comfort.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a menial worker; a person of low rank; a laborer bound to serve a creditor in Latin America
chinese: 卑微的勞工；雜役；苦力；（拉丁美洲）抵債勞工
example: The boss treats her like a peon.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to become aware of through the senses; to notice; to regard as; to understand
chinese: 察覺；感知；認為；看待；理解
example: I could perceive the ship coming over the horizon
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: able to be seen or noticed; perceivable; noticeable
chinese: 可察覺的；可感知的；明顯的
example: He pointed to the light in the sky—hardly perceptible to their older eyes.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: utter ruin; eternal damnation; hell
chinese: 毀滅；沉淪；永劫；地獄
example: We're on the road to perdition.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to travel or wander from place to place, especially on foot
chinese: 遊歷；漫遊；徒步旅行
example: peregrinate the bridge
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: insisting on immediate obedience; brusquely imperious; not open to debate; (law) final and absolute
chinese: 專橫的；不容反駁的；斷然的；（法律）最終的
example: There was no point in arguing after such a peremptory command.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: lasting for a long time; enduring; recurring again and again; (of plants) living several years; a perennial plant
chinese: adj. 長期的；持久的；反覆出現的；（植物）多年生的；n. 多年生植物
example: the common buttercup is a popular perennial plant
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: deceitful and untrustworthy; treacherous; disloyal
chinese: 背信棄義的；不忠的；奸詐的
example: The most perfidious way of harming a cause consists of defending it deliberately with faulty arguments.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: by necessity; unavoidably
chinese: 必然地；不得不；勢必
example: This had been done without her advice being asked, and must perforce be disapproved.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: carried out with minimum effort or reflection; superficial; routine
chinese: 敷衍的；草率的；例行公事的
example: The inspection was quite perfunctory.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the point in an orbit nearest to the earth; the lowest point
chinese: 近地點；（喻）最低點
example: In this context, “perigee” refers to periapsis in Earth orbit; the point in its orbit where a satellite is nearest to the Earth.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: full of danger or risk; hazardous; precarious
chinese: 危險的；冒險的；岌岌可危的
example: A coward is someone who, in a perilous emergency, thinks with his legs.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the outer limits or edge of an area; a marginal or secondary position or aspect
chinese: 外圍；邊緣；周邊；次要部分
example: Oxidation of fatty acids leads to a decrease in the use of glucose on the periphery.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: expressed in a roundabout way; using more words than necessary; wordy
chinese: 迂迴的；拐彎抹角的；冗長贅述的
example: The passage describes its subject as periphrastic, meaning roundabout and unnecessarily wordy; (`ambagious' is archaic).
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the offense of lying under oath; the breaking of an oath
chinese: 偽證；偽證罪；違背誓言
example: It is not possible to found a lasting power upon injustice, perjury, and treachery.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to spread throughout; to pervade; to pass through
chinese: 滲透；瀰漫；遍布
example: The world of dreams is a set of stages where virtual realities permeate one another.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way; highly injurious; deadly
chinese: 有害的；惡性的；致命的
example: Pervasive and pernicious deviations from both fact and logical validity lurked behind a meretricious plausibility.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the concluding part of a speech; a lengthy, flowery, highly rhetorical speech
chinese: （演說的）結尾；結語；冗長浮誇的演說
example: In this context, “peroration” refers to a flowery and highly rhetorical oration.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to carry out (a harmful or illegal act); to commit; to be guilty of
chinese: 犯（罪）；做（壞事）；施行（騙局）
example: What atrocities do we not perpetrate in the name of culture and refinement!
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to cause to continue indefinitely; to preserve; to prolong (a bad situation or belief)
chinese: 使延續；使永存；使持續（不良事物）
example: perpetuate a myth
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: inability to understand; bewilderment; a puzzling matter; complexity
chinese: 困惑；茫然；難題；錯綜複雜
example: He laughed heartily at my perplexity.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a benefit received in addition to salary; a perk; a right or privilege belonging to a position
chinese: 額外津貼；附加福利；特權；專有權利
example: Free housing was a valuable perquisite of the overseas appointment.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to continue steadily despite difficulty or delay; to persist
chinese: 堅持不懈；鍥而不捨；不屈不撓
example: He's determined to persevere in his work on behalf of equality and human rights.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a person or thing that embodies a quality; the attribution of human characteristics to something nonhuman
chinese: 化身；典型；擬人化；擬人法
example: she is the personification of optimism
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the quality of having keen insight and understanding; shrewdness
chinese: 洞察力；敏銳；睿智
example: I trust in his perspicacity.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: clearness and lucidity of expression
chinese: 清晰明瞭；明晰；易懂
example: In this context, “perspicuity” refers to clarity as a consequence of being perspicuous.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: impudent or saucy; lively and jaunty; neat and attractive in shape
chinese: 冒失的；放肆的；俏皮活潑的；小巧挺翹的
example: The model had a pert bottom and slender legs.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: relevant or applicable to a particular matter; to the point; appropriate
chinese: 相關的；切題的；中肯的；恰當的
example: Computer technology is indispensable to access many pertinent items of data.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to make anxious or uneasy; to throw into disorder; to cause to deviate from a normal state
chinese: 使不安；使心煩；擾亂；使偏離
example: Magical are the straight lines in how they perturb the curved ones, aggravate their distortion and make them look more zigzagged, revealing their deceptive appearance.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to read or examine carefully; (informally) to look over casually
chinese: 細讀；仔細研讀；瀏覽
example: I didn't have time to peruse the article.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to spread through and be present in every part of; to permeate
chinese: 瀰漫；遍及；滲透
example: Science and technology have come to pervade every aspect of our lives and, as a result, society is changing at a speed which is quite unprecedented.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: contrary to what is reasonable or expected; deliberately obstinate or contrary; wayward; morally wrong

definition: to sing with trills and embellishments; a warbling sound; a lump under an animal's hide caused by botfly larvae
chinese: v. 用顫音唱；（鳥）啁啾；n. 顫音；鳥鳴；（獸皮下）皮蠅瘤
example: In this context, “warble” refers to a lumpy abscess under the hide of domestic mammals caused by larvae of a botfly or warble fly.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to distort (meaning or judgment); to bend out of shape; the lengthwise threads on a loom; a distortion
chinese: v. 曲解；扭曲；（木材）翹曲；使變形；n. （織物）經紗；扭曲
example: Over time, wooden doors can warp or swell, making the door difficult to close.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: cautious about possible dangers or problems; watchful
chinese: 謹慎的；小心的；警惕的；機警的
example: Benedito taught the kids to be wary of snakes and other dangerous animals.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a person who wastes resources self-indulgently; a good-for-nothing
chinese: 揮霍者；敗家子；遊手好閒者
example: In this context, “wastrel” refers to someone who dissipates resources self-indulgently.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to become unsteady in resolve; to be undecided; to flicker or sway; (of a voice) to tremble
chinese: 動搖；猶豫不決；搖曳；（聲音）顫抖
example: We will also not waver in our values and our principles as a nation.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to grow larger or stronger; (of the moon) to show increasing illumination; to become; to coat with wax; a soft substance used for candles
chinese: v. 增大；漸強；（月）漸圓；變得；上蠟；n. 蠟；蠟狀物
example: The flame flickered as it consumed the wax and the wick of the candle.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: of great seriousness or importance; influential; heavy
chinese: 重大的；重要的；有份量的；有影響力的；沉重的
example: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to go or travel, usually slowly (wend one's way)
chinese: 行走；前往；（緩慢地）走
example: In this context, “wend” means direct one's course or way.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to persuade or obtain by flattery or coaxing
chinese: 哄騙；用甜言蜜語勸誘；騙取
example: I tried to wheedle him into telling me the answer.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to stimulate (desire or interest); to sharpen (a blade)
chinese: 刺激；激起（食慾或興趣）；磨（刀）
example: Was the cliffhanger a downer or did it whet your appetite for more?
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: playfully quaint or fanciful; odd; acting on whim; capricious
chinese: 古怪的；異想天開的；奇特有趣的；反覆無常的
example: She shaped the cake into a whimsical design.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to have and exercise (power or influence); to hold and use (a weapon or tool)
chinese: 行使（權力）；運用；揮舞；操作
example: They which play with the devil's rattles will be brought by degrees to wield his sword.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: deliberate; intentional; obstinately self-willed; headstrong
chinese: 故意的；蓄意的；任性的；固執的
example: Your willful disobedience is what got you here.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: skilled at gaining advantage by deception; cunning; crafty
chinese: 狡猾的；詭計多端的；老謀深算的
example: He plays a wily detective with a penchant for disguises.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to make a pained expression or flinch from pain or distress; a sudden pained grimace
chinese: v. 皺眉蹙額；畏縮；退縮；n. 皺眉；畏縮
example: Meanwhile, house parties and bar nights in college towns across the country are sparking outbreaks that make public health officials wince.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an unexpected gain or advantage; a piece of fruit blown down by the wind
chinese: 意外之財；意外收穫；被風吹落的果實
example: The unexpected windfall has put my brother and his wife on easy street.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: attractive or appealing in a charming, innocent way
chinese: 迷人的；討人喜歡的；可愛的
example: How could you dislike that winsome smile?
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: in addition; besides; nevertheless; (archaic) with, at the end of a clause
chinese: adv. 而且；此外；儘管如此；prep. （古）以
example: Straw is not given us, and bricks are required of us as before; behold we, thy servants, are beaten with whips, and thy people is unjustly dealt withal.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: shriveled and wrinkled with age or illness
chinese: 乾癟的；滿是皺紋的；枯萎的
example: The wizened, old sorcerer took me under his wing and taught me everything he knew about magic.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: great sorrow or distress; troubles (woes); misfortune
chinese: 悲痛；苦惱；災難；不幸
example: Woe to those who are obese in a society where slimness is the norm.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: resembling a wolf; greedy; ferocious
chinese: 似狼的；貪婪的；兇殘的
example: The passage describes its subject as wolfish, meaning resembling or characteristic (or considered characteristic) of a wolf.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: ordinary; commonplace; everyday; suitable for working days
chinese: 平凡的；普通的；日常的；工作日的
example: The passage describes its subject as workaday, meaning found in the ordinary course of events.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a ghost; an apparition; a phantom of a living person seen before death
chinese: 幽靈；鬼魂；幻影；（將死之人的）生魂
example: His voice was drowned out by the wraith's sudden howl.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a long, complicated dispute; to argue noisily; to obtain by persistent effort; to herd livestock
chinese: n. 爭吵；爭執；糾紛；v. 爭吵；爭論；設法取得；放牧（牲畜）
example: This contract dispute turned into a legal wrangle.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: extreme anger; rage; violent force (of nature)
chinese: 憤怒；盛怒；（自然的）猛烈
example: All the king's subjects, fearing his wrath, often acted quite servile.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to twist or pull violently; to sprain; to cause pain; to distort; a tool for turning nuts; a sudden twist; a painful parting
chinese: v. 猛扭；扭傷；使痛苦；曲解；n. 扳手；猛扭；（離別的）痛苦
example: Some call it a wrench, while others call it a spanner.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: to pull away forcefully; to obtain with great effort; to distort the meaning of
chinese: 奪取；強奪；費力取得；曲解
example: One of the kids tried to wrest his scooter out of the officer's hands.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: angry; wrathful
chinese: 憤怒的；激怒的
example: At this the innkeeper waxed very wroth, and threatened if he did not pay to compel him in a way that he would not like.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: (of metal) beaten into shape; carefully crafted; (wrought up) agitated; past tense of work: brought about
chinese: adj. 鍛造的；精心製作的；（情緒）激動的；v. 造成；引起
example: The suspect slipped and impaled himself while attempting to climb over a wrought iron fence.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: using or expressing dry, mocking humor; (of a face) twisted in disgust or disappointment; bent or crooked
chinese: 苦笑的；挖苦的；冷面幽默的；扭曲的；歪斜的
example: "What an idyllic picture," he said with a wry smile.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: dislike or fear of people from other countries or of strangers
chinese: 仇外心理；排外主義；懼外症
example: In this context, “xenophobia” refers to a fear of foreigners or strangers.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: resembling wood; having the nature of wood
chinese: 木質的；似木的
example: The passage describes its subject as xyloid, meaning Resembling wood; having the nature of wood.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: an intense desire or longing; the basic monetary unit of Japan
chinese: 渴望；嚮往；日圓
example: Every month, he saved ten thousand yen out of his income for his daughter.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a burden or bond of oppression; a wooden crosspiece joining draft animals; a fitted part of a garment; to join or link; to harness
chinese: n. 束縛；壓迫；牛軛；（衣服）抵肩；v. 結合；連接；套上軛
example: The yoke of marriage is so heavy that it takes two people to carry it – sometimes three.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: amusingly unconventional and eccentric; clownishly crazy; a clown or buffoon
chinese: adj. 滑稽的；古怪好笑的；瘋瘋癲癲的；n. 小丑；丑角
example: The otherwise dark and serious comic is punctuated by pages of zany side stories.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: great energy or enthusiasm for a cause or objective
chinese: 熱忱；熱情；熱心
example: But no disciple can be excused if he does not have zeal.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of political or religious ideals
chinese: 狂熱者；狂熱分子；極端分子
example: James was a right-wing zealot.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: the highest point of success or power; the point in the sky directly overhead
chinese: 頂峰；巔峰；（天文）天頂
example: His fame was at its zenith at that time.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: a soft, gentle breeze; the west wind; (Greek mythology) the god of the west wind
chinese: 和風；微風；西風；（希臘神話）西風之神
example: In this context, “zephyr” refers to (Greek mythology) the Greek god of the west wind.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary

definition: great enthusiasm and energy; piquancy or flavor; the outer peel of a citrus fruit
chinese: 熱情；興致；風味；趣味；（柑橘）果皮
example: Ginger — whether it's fresh, powdered or pickled — adds zest to all sorts of dishes.
sources: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized vocabulary
